verdict.rationale: The only related evidence says you can point at an element or annotate a screenshot so the assistant can pick it up. That is still a prompt round-trip through the AI, not direct in-place editing of text, style, or layout. No visual or direct-manipulation editor is documented, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a designer, I can select an element and edit its text, style, or layout directly without a prompt round-trip
